name: Rahul Maurya
headline: Software Engineer · Backend & Distributed Systems

au.summary: Backend software engineer with {years} years building and running event-driven Java / Spring Boot microservices for warehouse automation (WES / WCS / ASRS) that enterprise clients operate 24/7. Currently forward-deployed on a live distribution centre in Melbourne, where I raised goods-to-person picking throughput by 50% and closed the gap to a contracted SLA. Strong in distributed systems, messaging (RabbitMQ, Kafka), Kubernetes and production observability, with hands-on LLM tooling experience.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Forward-deployed on a **20+ microservice** warehouse execution platform (Java 17, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, SQL Server, Kubernetes / Helm) for a tier-1 global retail brand's distribution centre; own change requests from design through production rollout.

Raised goods-to-person picking throughput from **800 to 1,200 totes/hr (+50%)** by tracing per-stage dwell time and fixing work-release and allocation logic, closing the gap to the contracted SLA and unblocking a **seven-figure (AUD)** contractual milestone.

Built a cross-service irregular-event store (RabbitMQ to MongoDB, correlation-id indexed) with Grafana views, replacing manual log searches across pods with a single correlated query for root-cause analysis.
Segregated competing business flows on shared automation, improving client operational efficiency by **30%**.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
bullets: Decomposed monolithic modules of a Warehouse Control System into **12+ Spring Boot microservices** over RabbitMQ, cutting p95 API latency from **800 ms to 600 ms (−25%)**.
Built a real-time event pipeline on MongoDB with tuned MySQL / SQL Server queries, processing **10,000+ events/min with zero data loss** (idempotent consumers, dead-letter queues, replay).
Sustained **99.6% uptime** across production sites through Docker / Kubernetes deployments and Jenkins CI/CD.
Built an LLM-powered inventory assistant (RAG plus read-only tool calls) that auto-resolves **75%+** of operator queries, reducing support tickets by **40%**.
Wrote a Python tool that migrates Grafana dashboards across 3 network environments (200+ dashboards), cutting each migration from **8 hours to 20 minutes**.
Delivered monitoring and hardware health dashboards that cut incident response time by **60%**; shipped WMS features to **5+ enterprise clients** in Scrum teams with QA, DevOps and Product.
